通用.缺少英文简写.zh: 当前命令未配置英文简写，请联系管理员在控制台添加
通用.缺少英文简写.en: No English shortcut is configured for this command. Ask an administrator to add one in the console.

通用.编号用法.zh:
请输入配置编号
示例：
{sniper_delete} 3

通用.配置不存在.en: No rule with that number was found.

系统.测试推送.zh: ✅ RivenSniper v{version} 这是一条测试推送。
系统.测试推送.en: ✅ RivenSniper v{version} This is a test notification.

狙击添加.达到上限.zh: 无法添加，当前会话最多保存 {limit} 条狙击配置
狙击添加.达到上限.en: You can save at most {limit} sniper rules here.

狙击添加.解析失败.zh:
添加失败：{error}
请修改后重试

狙击列表.空.zh:
暂无狙击配置
示例：
{sniper_add} Torid cc ms cd -any
填写 2 或 3 个正词条；-any 表示任意负词条，不写则要求无负词条
狙击列表.空.en:
No sniper rules yet.
Example:
{sniper_add} Torid cc ms cd -any
Use 2 or 3 positive stats. -any requires a negative stat; omit it to require no negative stat.

黑名单添加.用法.zh:
请输入卖家名 列如:
{blacklist_add} SomeSeller
单独屏蔽WM或者频道：
{blacklist_add} WM SomeSeller
{blacklist_add} Channel SomeSeller
批量添加示例，每行一个卖家名：
{blacklist_add} WM
SellerOne
Seller Two
黑名单仅过滤紫卡狙击，不影响捡漏
黑名单添加.用法.en:
Enter a seller name.Examples:
{blacklist_add} SomeSeller
Block WM or channels separately:
{blacklist_add} WM SomeSeller
{blacklist_add} Channel SomeSeller
For a bulk add, use one seller per line:
{blacklist_add} WM
SellerOne
Seller Two
Blacklists filter Riven sniper notifications, not bargain notifications.

黑名单添加.名称过长.zh: 第 {line} 行卖家名超过 {limit} 个字符
黑名单添加.名称过长.en: The seller name on line {line} exceeds {limit} characters.

黑名单添加.成功.en: {name} was added to the seller blacklist.

黑名单添加.已存在.en: {name} is already on the seller blacklist.

黑名单添加.批量完成.zh: 批量添加完成：新增 {added} 个，已存在 {existing} 个

黑名单删除.用法.zh:
请输入卖家名
示例：
{blacklist_delete} SomeSeller
{blacklist_delete} WM SomeSeller
{blacklist_delete} Channel SomeSeller
黑名单删除.用法.en:
Enter a seller name.
Examples:
{blacklist_delete} WM SomeSeller
{blacklist_delete} Channel SomeSeller
Without a scope: remove from both WM and Channel if channel messages are enabled; otherwise WM only.

黑名单删除.成功.en: {name} was removed from the seller blacklist.

黑名单删除.不存在.en: {name} is not on the seller blacklist.

黑名单.子命令错误.zh:
用法：
{blacklist_list} WM
{blacklist_list} Channel
添加或删除示例：
{blacklist_add} WM SomeSeller
{blacklist_delete} WM SomeSeller
黑名单.子命令错误.en:
Usage:
{blacklist_list} WM
{blacklist_list} Channel
Add or remove a seller:
{blacklist_add} WM SomeSeller
{blacklist_delete} WM SomeSeller

开盒.用法.zh:
按玩家查询：
{tracking_open} SomePlayer
按紫卡编号查询：
{tracking_open_riven} 3
分页与导出示例：
{tracking_open} SomePlayer page 2
{tracking_open_riven} 3 all
开盒.用法.en:
Look up a player:
{tracking_open} SomePlayer
Look up a Riven number:
{tracking_open_riven} 3
Page or export examples:
{tracking_open} SomePlayer page 2
{tracking_open_riven} 3 all

开盒.无结果.zh: 频道追踪库中没有“{query}”的可靠记录
开盒.无结果.en: No reliable channel record was found for "{query}".

开盒.页码超限.zh: 页码 {page} 超出范围，共 {pages} 页
开盒.页码超限.en: Page {page} is out of range; there are {pages} pages.

开盒.导出过大.zh: 历史共 {total} 条，超过单次导出上限 {limit} 条，请使用分页查询
开盒.导出过大.en: This history has {total} records and exceeds the {limit}-record export limit. Use paged queries instead.

上线提醒.用法.zh:
添加频道提醒：
{tracker_add} SomePlayer
查看提醒：
{tracker_list}
删除提醒：
{tracker_delete} 3
上线提醒.用法.en:
Add a channel alert:
{tracker_add} SomePlayer
List alerts:
{tracker_list}
Delete an alert:
{tracker_delete} 3.

上线提醒.待识别已添加.zh:
频道提醒 {id} 已添加：{name}
等待首次在受监控频道中识别到该玩家
上线提醒.待识别已添加.en:
Channel alert {id} saved for {name}.
Waiting to identify this player in a monitored channel.

上线提醒.离开.zh: 频道提醒：{name} 已离开所有受监控频道
上线提醒.离开.en: Channel alert: {name} left all monitored channels.

去重.用法.zh:
查看当前间隔：
{channel_dedupe}
设置间隔示例：
{channel_dedupe} 24
单位为小时，只接受 1～72 的整数
去重.用法.en:
View the current interval:
{channel_dedupe}
Set the interval:
{channel_dedupe} 24
Enter an integer from 1 to 72 hours.

去重.当前.zh:
频道紫卡去重间隔：{hours} 小时
同一张紫卡再次出现时，距上次被观察到至少 {hours} 小时，才有机会再次推送
去重.当前.en:
Channel Riven dedupe interval: {hours} hours.
A Riven can be sent again only if at least {hours} hours have passed since it was last observed.

去重.成功.zh:
频道紫卡去重间隔已设为 {hours} 小时
同一张紫卡再次出现时，距上次被观察到至少 {hours} 小时，才有机会再次推送
去重.成功.en:
Channel Riven dedupe interval set to {hours} hours.
A Riven can be sent again only if at least {hours} hours have passed since it was last observed.

狙击推送.私聊.zh:
私聊
/w {seller} hi wtb your "{weapon_en} {riven}" riven for {price} platinum.
狙击推送.私聊.en:
DM
/w {seller} Hi! I want to buy your "{weapon_en} {riven}" riven for {price} platinum.

捡漏添加.用法.zh:
请输入道具名
示例：
{bargain_add} Arcane Grace 0 25
0 表示未升级，满级使用 max；无等级道具省略等级
25 表示低于参考价至少 25%；省略时使用系统默认门槛
捡漏添加.用法.en:
Enter an item name.
Example:
{bargain_add} Arcane Grace 0 25
Use 0 for unranked or max for max rank; omit the rank for items without ranks.
25 means at least 25% below reference. Omit it to use the system default.

捡漏添加.找不到.zh:
未找到道具“{name}”
可使用中文、英文或别名，也可输入部分名称
捡漏添加.找不到.en:
Item "{name}" was not found.
Use a Chinese or English name, an alias, or part of the name.

捡漏添加.数据缺失.zh: 道具目录不可用，请联系管理员
捡漏添加.数据缺失.en: The item catalogue is unavailable. Please contact an administrator.

捡漏添加.多个匹配.en:
"{name}" matches multiple items. Use a more complete name:
{candidates}

捡漏添加.已存在.en: {name} is already on the item watch list.

捡漏添加.达到上限.zh: 已达全局监控上限，最多监控 {limit} 种不同道具或武器
捡漏添加.达到上限.en: The global watch limit is {limit} distinct items or weapons.

捡漏添加.折扣格式错误.zh:
低于参考价的百分比无效：“{value}”
请输入 5～90 的整数，例如 25 表示低于参考价至少 25%
捡漏添加.折扣格式错误.en:
Invalid percentage below reference: "{value}".
Enter an integer from 5 to 90. For example, 25 means at least 25% below reference.

捡漏列表.空.zh:
暂无道具捡漏监控
示例：
{bargain_add} Arcane Grace 0 25
25 表示低于参考价至少 25%
捡漏列表.空.en:
No item bargain watches yet.
Example:
{bargain_add} Arcane Grace 0 25
25 means at least 25% below reference.

捡漏删除.用法.zh:
请输入监控编号
示例：
{bargain_delete} 3

捡漏紫卡.用法.zh:
添加紫卡监控：
{bargain_riven_add} Torid 30
30 表示低于参考价至少 30%；省略时使用系统默认门槛
查看监控：
{bargain_riven_list}
删除监控：
{bargain_riven_delete} 3
捡漏紫卡.用法.en:
Add a Riven watch:
{bargain_riven_add} Torid 30
30 means at least 30% below reference. Omit it to use the system default.
List watches:
{bargain_riven_list}
Delete a watch:
{bargain_riven_delete} 3

捡漏紫卡.找不到武器.zh:
未找到武器“{name}”
请使用游戏内中文名或英文名
捡漏紫卡.找不到武器.en: Weapon "{name}" was not found. Use its exact in-game name.

捡漏紫卡.已存在.en: {name} is already on the Riven watch list.

捡漏紫卡.达到上限.zh: 已达全局监控上限，最多监控 {limit} 种不同道具或武器
捡漏紫卡.达到上限.en: The global watch limit is {limit} distinct items or weapons.

捡漏紫卡.列表空.zh:
暂无紫卡捡漏监控
示例：
{bargain_riven_add} Torid 30
30 表示低于参考价至少 30%
捡漏紫卡.列表空.en:
No Riven bargain watches yet.
Example:
{bargain_riven_add} Torid 30
30 means at least 30% below reference.

捡漏紫卡.删除用法.zh:
请输入监控编号
示例：
{bargain_riven_delete} 3
